source_findings.finding: batch executes member placements serially. P168's hook-relative pre-call interval already includes P167's execution; it is not 43.2554ms spent solely checking member2. The10.4571ms gap also includes the earlier member's remaining context/log work and later member preflight/worker admission; the old log cannot partition those APIs.

place and delayed-completion paths assign post_observed_qpc immediately after Catalog::get and before observe_placement_completion. That observer performs actual identity/GUI/capture/display checks. Thus the old NF02 endpoint undercounts complete post-context, and12.5652ms is not a measured total postverification duration.

Even a fresh-verified size-preserving Placement passes cx/cy without SWP_NOSIZE. Retaining size explicitly removes this unnecessary size request. The old logs do not prove how much it contributed to23.5305ms or that it is the sole latency cause.

limits: No new native trial or performance PASS is granted by this review.
The current small sample9-native p95 bucket99999us/max79352us remains a failure against the50ms target.
Scheduling, Catalog limit-query/COM/security costs and native target handling cannot be separately attributed from the old clocks.
Fresh identity, permission, capture and revocation checks are not removed as a shortcut.
Any successor product has a new source/hash. Its complete-context endpoint is reported separately; old results are not rebound or directly called equivalent.
Software QPC observations are not physical display latency or a cross-machine time line.
